title: Binder: canonicalize numeric member names (GetPropertyNameForPropertyNameNode)
description: Upstream names a numeric member by the scanner's canonical value (0b11 binds as '3', 1.0 as '1'; ast/utilities.go:3160 Text() = token value), so duplicate spellings merge into one symbol. This binder keys the source text, so they stay two symbols. Fix needs an owned string with the store's lifetime — thread an arena through FileInfo/bind_into (140 construction sites) or carry the canonical value on NumericLiteral via codegen. ~6 binder_symbols cases: duplicateIdentifierDifferentSpelling, numericClassMembers1, objectTypeWithDuplicateNumericProperty, dynamicNamesErrors, numericStringNamedPropertyEquivalence, duplicateObjectLiteralProperty_computedName1. Also unblocks the recorded signed-numeric gap in dynamic_name (binder.rs).
